## Load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(DescTools)
```


# Load data

Set paths to data directory and output directory
```{r}
data_path = "path/to/data"

output_path  = "path/to/save/outputs"
```

```{r}
esviritu_res <- fread(paste0(data_path, "Esviritu_HostDiseaseGenometypeV5.tsv"))

esviritu_res_human <- esviritu_res %>% 
  filter(host_species == "Homo sapiens")

sample_metadata <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")
```

## Function for RPKMF value calculation (at taxa level)

```{r}
RPKMF_df <- function(data, tax_level){
  RPKMF_df <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_id, !!sym(tax_level)) %>%
    summarize(RPKMF = sum(true_rpkmf)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  RPKMF_df_wide <-pivot_wider(data=RPKMF_df,
                    names_from = sample_id,
                    values_from = RPKMF,
                    values_fill = list(RPKMF=0))

  return(RPKMF_df_wide)
}
```

## Function to calculate species count (or other taxa) at sample level

```{r}
summarize_tax_levels <- function(data){
  data %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    summarize(phylums=n_distinct(phylum),
              classes=n_distinct(tclass),
              orders=n_distinct(order),
              families=n_distinct(family),
              genera=n_distinct(genus),
              species=n_distinct(species),
              subspecies=n_distinct(subspecies),
              .groups="drop")
}
```


## Change in RPKMF during the sampling period

```{r}
RPKMF_sum_data <- function(data, taxa_level, band_type){
  
  RPKMF_data <- RPKMF_df(data, taxa_level)

  RPKMF_data <- as.data.frame(rowSums(t(RPKMF_data[, -1])))
  RPKMF_data$sample_ID <- rownames(RPKMF_data)
  colnames(RPKMF_data)[1] <- "value"
    
  
  RPKMF_data_meta <- merge(RPKMF_data, 
                           sample_metadata %>%
                             select(c("sample_ID", "Year_month", "Year_cat", 
                                      "City", "Month","Month_chr")))

  if (band_type=="min_max"){ 
  RPKMF_data_sum <- RPKMF_data_meta %>%
    group_by(Year_cat, Month_chr) %>%
    summarise(median_value = median(value),
              min_value = min(value),
              max_value = max(value),
              .groups = "drop")%>%
  complete(Year_cat, Month_chr, 
           fill = list(median_value = 0,
                       min_value  = 0,
                       max_value  = 0))
  } else{
    RPKMF_data_sum <- RPKMF_data_meta %>%
    group_by(Year_cat, Month_chr) %>%
    summarize(values=value,
              median_value =  MedianCI(x=values, method="boot")[["median"]],
              min_value = MedianCI(x=values, method="boot")[["lwr.ci"]],
              max_value = MedianCI(x=values, method="boot")[["upr.ci"]],
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    complete(Year_cat, Month_chr, 
            fill = list(median_value = 0,
                        min_value  = 0,
                        max_value  = 0))
  }
  
  RPKMF_data_sum$Month_chr <- factor(RPKMF_data_sum$Month_chr,
                                       levels=c("April", "May", "June","July",
                                                "August", "September", "October",
                                                "November", "December","January",
                                                "February", "March"))

  return(RPKMF_data_sum)
}
```


```{r, warning=FALSE}

RPKMF_data_human_95CI <- RPKMF_sum_data(data = esviritu_res_human, 
                                        taxa_level = "species", 
                                        band_type="CI")

RPKMF_data_enteric_95CI <- RPKMF_sum_data(data = esviritu_res_human %>%
                                            filter(tropism_broad=="Enteric"), 
                                          taxa_level = "species", band_type="CI")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
pal <- c("#7B71B6", "#E06666")


plot_RPKMF <- function(data){

    plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Month_chr, color=Year_cat, group=Year_cat)) +
            geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_value, ymax = max_value, 
                  fill=Year_cat), alpha = 0.3, linewidth=0.2) +
            geom_line(aes(y = median_value), size = 1) +
            scale_color_manual(values=c("2020-2021"=pal[1], "2024-2025"=pal[2]), name="") +
            scale_fill_manual(values=c("2020-2021"=pal[1], "2024-2025"=pal[2]), name="") +
            labs(y="RPKMF", x="") +
            scale_x_discrete(labels = c( April="April", May="May", June="June", 
                                         July="July", August="Aug.", September="Sept.", 
                                         October="Oct.",November="Nov.", 
                                         December="Dec.", January="Jan.",
                                         February="Feb.", March="March")) +
            theme_bw() +
            ylim(0,830) +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
                  legend.position = "none")
  
  return(plot)
}


RPKMF_human_viruses_95CI <- plot_RPKMF(RPKMF_data_human_95CI)
RPKMF_human_viruses_95CI

ggsave(RPKMF_human_viruses_95CI, 
       file = paste0(output_path, "RPKMF_human_viruses_95CI.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)


RPKMF_enteric_95CI <- plot_RPKMF(RPKMF_data_enteric_95CI)
RPKMF_enteric_95CI

ggsave(RPKMF_enteric_95CI, 
       file = paste0(output_path, "RPKMF_enteric_95CI.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)


```

## Change in species count during the sampling period

```{r}
species_count_data <- function(data, taxa_level, band_type){
  
  s_count <- summarize_tax_levels(data)[,c("sample_id", taxa_level)]

  s_count_meta <- merge(s_count, 
                        sample_metadata %>%
                          select(c("sample_ID", "Year_month", "Year_cat", 
                                   "City", "Month", "Month_chr")),
                        by.x="sample_id", by.y="sample_ID")

  
  if (band_type=="min_max"){ 
    s_count_sum <- s_count_meta %>%
      group_by(Year_cat, Month_chr) %>%
      summarise(median_value = median(species),
                min_value = min(species),
                max_value = max(species),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      complete(Year_cat, Month_chr, 
               fill = list(median_value = 0,
                           min_value  = 0,
                           max_value  = 0))
  } else{
    s_count_sum <- s_count_meta %>%
      group_by(Year_cat, Month_chr) %>%
      summarize(values=species,
                median_value =  MedianCI(x=values, method="boot")[["median"]],
                min_value = MedianCI(x=values, method="boot")[["lwr.ci"]],
                max_value = MedianCI(x=values, method="boot")[["upr.ci"]],
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      complete(Year_cat, Month_chr, 
               fill = list(median_value = 0,
                           min_value  = 0,
                           max_value  = 0))
  }
  
  s_count_sum$Month_chr <- factor(s_count_sum$Month_chr,
                                  levels=c("April", "May", "June","July",
                                           "August", "September", "October",
                                           "November", "December","January",
                                           "February",  "March"))

  return(s_count_sum)
}
```


```{r}
s_count_data_human_95CI <- species_count_data(esviritu_res_human, "species", band_type="CI")

s_count_data_mucocutaneous_95CI <- species_count_data(esviritu_res_human %>%
                                                        filter(tropism_broad =="Mucocutaneous"), 
                                                      taxa_level = "species", 
                                                      band_type="CI")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
pal <- c("#7B71B6", "#E06666")

plot_species_count <- function(data){
    plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Month_chr, color=Year_cat, group=Year_cat)) +
      
            geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_value, ymax = max_value, color=Year_cat, 
                  fill=Year_cat), alpha = 0.3, linewidth=0.1) +
            geom_line(aes(y = median_value), size = 1) +
            scale_color_manual(values=c("2020-2021"=pal[1], "2024-2025"=pal[2]), name="") +
            scale_fill_manual(values=c("2020-2021"=pal[1], "2024-2025"=pal[2]), name="") +
            labs(y="Number of detected species") +
            scale_x_discrete(labels = c(April="April", May="May", June="June", 
                                        July="July", August="Aug.", September="Sept.", 
                                        October="Oct.",November="Nov.", 
                                        December="Dec.", January="Jan.",
                                        February="Feb.", March="March")) +
            theme_bw() +
            labs(x="") +
            ylim(0,99) +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
                  legend.position = "none")
    
    return(plot)
}
```

```{r}
species_count_human_95CI <- plot_species_count(s_count_data_human_95CI)
species_count_human_95CI

ggsave(species_count_human_95CI,

       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)



species_count_mucocutaneous_95CI <- plot_species_count(s_count_data_mucocutaneous_95CI)
species_count_mucocutaneous_95CI
```
